test_name: PII Processing and Transparency PT-4 Evidence Review 073
architecture:
System: Identity-Core-073
Environment: Citizen Services
Assessment focus: PT-4 (PII Processing and Transparency).
Observed evidence: An optional demographic survey collects disability and ethnicity information before presenting any consent choice. The responses are then sent to a third-party analytics service and retained with the applicant identifier.

ground_truth.decision_basis: Sensitive optional PII is collected and disclosed before an effective consent mechanism is presented.
ground_truth.severity_policy: R4 — The evidence shows a current/confirmed severe condition: active compromise or destructive activity; actual sensitive-data disclosure/loss; actual unauthorized privileged use; direct public/unencrypted exposure of sensitive data or credentials; an internet-facing known exploitable critical flaw without mitigation; or a confirmed integrity-bypassed/tampered production artifact.

provenance: Synthetic holdout-candidate scenario authored independently of the original rubric-aligned 200-case pack.
adjudication_change_reason: V1 label retained under the four-level severity rubric.
